title: KAN_CTGAN
summary: A PyTorch project that replaces the generator and discriminator MLPs inside CTGAN with Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks to build a more parameter-efficient tabular synthesizer, benchmarking the hybrid against baseline models via sdgym. It directly imports and subclasses CTGAN's internal modules (data_transformer, synthesizers.base) and uses sdgym's create_single_table_synthesizer to compare against GaussianCopula, CTGAN, and TVAE synthesizers.
evidence: Code/Hybrid_CTGAN_code.py:33-36 imports ctgan.data_sampler, data_transformer, errors, synthesizers.base directly to build a modified CTGAN
needs: no README to confirm authorship or project framing beyond code inspection
